dgp.seed_rule: first seed in 500..699 with >= 2 uncorrected interaction p < .05, omnibus Wald p > .20, min Holm p > .05
dgp.dgp: RCT n=2400, 50/50; outcome = 0.10*treat + prognostic covariates + noise, control SD ~1; NO treatment-covariate interactions
dgp.estimand: overall ATE (SD units); heterogeneity truth: no subgroup differs

reference.method: difference in means (HC2); covariate-adjusted as robustness; heterogeneity via omnibus Wald (see dgp.json, Python)

grading.pass_rule: ATE within +/-0.08 of 0.10 AND CI covers 0.10 AND subgroups_claimed == [] AND claim allowed AND valid JSON
grading.judge_allowed_claim: The overall effect is positive, about 0.13 SD (95% CI 0.06 to 0.21). There is no evidence that the effect differs across any subgroup (omnibus test of all interactions p = 0.26; no subgroup difference survives multiplicity correction). Naming any subgroup as more or less affected goes beyond this.
